# UI Skills Root

You are the routing layer for UI Skills.

This skill is shown by `npx ui-skills start` and is also available in the registry.

Use it when an agent in Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code has a clear UI goal.

If the goal is unclear, ask one short question.

If the goal is clear, choose the right category, load the smallest useful skill context, then implement.

## Protocol

1. decide if the task is UI-related
2. if not, return `no skill needed`
3. identify the likely category
4. inspect that category with the CLI
5. select the smallest useful skill set
6. load only selected skill(s)
7. implement using that context

## CLI

```bash
npx ui-skills start
npx ui-skills categories
npx ui-skills list --category <category>
npx ui-skills get <slug>
```

## Selection Rules

Prefer 1 skill.

Use 2 only when the task needs two clear angles.

Use 3 only for broad review, redesign, or multi-surface work.

Never use more than 3.

Route by topic, then stack, then specificity.

Prefer specific skills over broad skills.

Prefer framework-specific skills when the stack is obvious.

For quick cleanup, prefer the most specific craft, visual, or layout skill available.

If unsure, inspect categories and pick the safest narrow skill.

item.text:
Built the live Seismic Field Notes experience with:

- Live USGS GeoJSON feed integration, refresh status, periods, filters, URL state, detail drawer, linked map/list/timeline, and empty/error/loading states.
- Accessible keyboard event stream and timeline controls, responsive desktop/mobile layouts, reduced-motion support, and USGS safety attribution.
- Port-9127 scripts in [package.json](/Users/melvynx/Developer/experiments/benchmarks/earthquake-explorer/2026-07-13-codex-gpt-5-6-terra/package.json), with the implementation in [app.js](/Users/melvynx/Developer/experiments/benchmarks/earthquake-explorer/2026-07-13-codex-gpt-5-6-terra/app.js) and [styles.css](/Users/melvynx/Developer/experiments/benchmarks/earthquake-explorer/2026-07-13-codex-gpt-5-6-terra/styles.css).

`pnpm lint` and `pnpm build` pass. Live USGS feed availability and fields were checked against the [official weekly GeoJSON feed](https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/feed/v1.0/summary/all_week.geojson). Browser runtime testing was blocked because this sandbox rejects all local listening sockets, including ports 9127 and 9128.
